Name: Villager Pet Kent
Author: blancium
Description:
A long time ago, in a universe far removed from canon, Kent was captured by the Gotoro Empire and trained to be a dog slave. He was abandoned for newer, fresher meat and has since made his way to your farm - what will you do with him?

Jk but wouldn't that be cool?

Anyways. Same as my Alex dog mod. Retextures a dog to be a naked Kent. Should be compatible with the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24026]Pet's Enhanced[/url] mod, but if you go over there do NOT mention me or this mod, thanks so much mwah.

If you're super attached to the german shepherd dog and want Kent to replace a different pet, just pop open the content.json file and change

        "Target": "Animals/dog1",

to

﻿"Target": "Animals/[dog of your choice here]",

As always, special thanks to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Udunie/]@udunie[/url] for the feedback during the spriting process!!

[size=5]NOT* COMPATIBLE WITH PETS ENHANCED
[/size]
The way Pets Enhanced is set up now prioritizes loading from its own assets.

*If you want to use this with Pets Enhanced like I had originally intended, please see below:

The spritesheet I created to work with it in the latest update is compatible, but you will need to go in and replace the spritesheet of the dog of your choice [i]in the Pets Enhanced mod folder
[/i]
Location: Pets Enhanced Mod > assets > Animals > Dog

Steps
1. Go to the above folder and find the spritesheet of the dog you want to replace
2. Rename the "kentdog" spritesheet in the assets folder of MY mod to the name of spritesheet of the dog you want to replace
3. Copy/paste the newly named kentdog spritesheet into the Pets Enhanced Mod/assets/Animals/Dog folder and choose to REPLACE the existing file
4. Goon
